Of the 46 remaining items, I'll estimate how many answer yes to "Is it alive?".

Alive: apple, banana, bee, butterfly, cactus, carrot, cat, chicken, cow, dog, dolphin, eagle, elephant, frog, goldfish, grass, horse, lemon, oak tree, penguin, potato, rose, seaweed, shark, snake, spider, sunflower. That is 27 if the plants and fruits count as alive. Hair, eye, hand, heart and tooth are ambiguous, so they might also count. About 27 of 46 is a fairly even split.

"Is it an animal?" would give about 17 yes (bee, butterfly, cat, chicken, cow, dog, dolphin, eagle, elephant, frog, goldfish, horse, penguin, shark, snake, spider) out of 46, which is less even.
